appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Monthly Sales for Store B in City Y'.
X-axis has labeled ticks for 'April', 'May', and 'June'.
Y-axis has labeled ticks from 0 to 600 in increments of 50.
A horizontal dashed line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 550 sales level.
All bars are solid blue, with no visible gradient or pattern.
Bar heights are visually proportional to the sales values indicated by the y-axis.

printed_facts.fact: The bar for April reaches the 550 sales level, exactly aligning with the 'Average' dashed line.
The bar for May reaches the 325 sales level, below the 'Average' line.
The bar for June reaches the 475 sales level, below the 'Average' line.
The horizontal dashed line is labeled 'Average' and is positioned at 550 sales.
The chart title is 'Monthly Sales for Store B in City Y'.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the Store B monthly sales dashboard for April through June, then choose the June route in the monthly bonus operations form.
The primary field label is 'June sales route'.
The options are: 'Route June to above-average sales bonus response', 'Route June to low-sales response', 'Keep June on normal sales monitoring'.
The chart reference is to use the Store B sales dashboard as the evidence source for the June sales route.
